rca of the issue: Previous iter298 root cause: /api/auth/refresh preferred the httpOnly cookie candidate blindly, so after a bearer-driven rotation the still-valid new bearer got shadowed by the stale cookie, triggering reuse detection → 401 + family revoke → UI logout loop. Fix (verified this iteration) in auth_jwt.py: collect BOTH cookie and Authorization Bearer, decode all valid candidates, and if >1 valid, use auth_store.pick_active_jti() to select the still-active jti. Regression test test_iter299_auth_refresh_regression.py::test_refresh_stale_cookie_plus_valid_bearer proves the previously-failing case now returns 200.
